description: Top-level comments of a public TikTok video from TikTok's web comment list JSON: comment ID, text, likes, reply count, time, language, pinned/liked-by-creator flags and the commenter's ID, username and nickname, plus the video's total comment count. Up to 60 comments in TikTok's own ranking order (no reply threads). An unknown or deleted video ID returns an empty list with total 0. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_tiktok_creative_center_top_ads when you need TikTok Creative Center Top Ads: the top-performing TikTok; social_tiktok_hashtag_analytics when you need TikTok hashtag stats from TikTok's public hashtag detail. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: TikTok video URL (tiktok.com/@user/video/<id>) or the numeric video ID
